meta.title: Implement folding of pure calls in VM
meta.body_summary: Fold pure function calls during VM compilation; store constant let bindings in compiler environment; update golden IR outputs.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit VM constant folding merged instantly by author with no review; only narrative in PR body, golden IR outputs updated, no benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 122 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step compiler optimization PR that merged instantly without review, consistent with a low-risk change that updates golden test outputs.

review_details.performance_claim: Fold pure function calls at compile time to eliminate runtime overhead of calling pure functions with constant arguments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing compile-time constant folding of pure calls is a recognized compiler optimization pattern; when scoped to a single VM pass and accompanied by updated golden tests, it can be accepted without review, showing agent competence in standard compiler techniques.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, implemented constant folding of pure function calls at compile time by evaluating and substituting constant values; updated golden IR outputs in tests/vm/valid/len_string.ir.out and str_builtin.ir.out to reflect the folding.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Golden test outputs updated to match new folding behavior; they serve as verification.
